4) Evidence for security: Ryan asked for a compact acceptance checklist for their security team (SOC2 pointers, retention policy, audit log sample). I included a short appendix in the MAP — please add any missing artifacts.

- Week 0 (Nov 15): Provisioning, access, baseline metrics collection, security evidence handoff
- Weeks 1-2 (Nov 16–Nov 29): Canary 5%
- Week 3 (Nov 30–Dec 6): Expand pilot 20%
- Weeks 4-5 (Dec 7–Dec 20): Staged migration and training
- Week 6 (Dec 21–Dec 27): Final acceptance window

Please reply inline with short confirmations or questions. I want to lock the MAP by Tue 11/09 so Ryan can take it to his execs.
